provenance.source: section 2 of the LingoLOGOS ASIC specification
provenance.kind: fixed reference weights, not quantized network weights
note: These are the INT8 constants the specification ships as the mesh test vector set.
No INT8 quantization of artifacts/grammar_weights.pt exists in this repository, so this
matrix must not be read as the compiled projection of the trained PCFG.
accumulator_bits is the signed width of every row sum and of every partial sum in the
generated adder tree; the compiler refuses a matrix whose partial sums do not fit it.
